## Purpose

Start the nightly investigation of open issues in `ElectricJack/agent-queue`.
See the [triage guide](../../guides/github-issue-triage.md) for the review flow.

## When a playbook uses it

The inactive reviewed `github-issue-triage` bundle calls it on `cron.02:00`.

## How it works internally

`GitHubIssueCommandsMixin._cmd_github_issue_triage` in
`src/commands/github_issue_commands.py` reads unlabelled open issues oldest
first. It counts investigation tasks created today, including archived tasks,
and files at most five new tasks. It then adds `aq-triaged` to each issue.

## Side effects and persistence

Each investigation task has a stable issue deduplication key. Task creation
precedes the GitHub label write, so a later run reuses a filed task and repairs
a missing label. The returned `filed` and `recovered` arrays distinguish those
two cases.

## Failure modes and diagnostics

An invalid project binding, GitHub access failure, or task filing failure
returns `rejected` and fails the playbook run. Inspect the run with
`aq playbook show-run <run-id>`; the next nightly scan can recover an unlabelled
issue whose task was already filed.

## Example step

The `investigate-nightly` rule passes `{"project_id": "agent-queue"}` to
`github_issue_triage` and treats `swept` as success.
